title: ShiaanX Fixture Specification
description: Machine-readable fixture specification per CNC setup, produced by fixture_planner.py

vise_model.description: Specific vise model if known, e.g. 'Kurt D688'. Null if unspecified.

jaw_opening_mm.description: Required jaw opening in mm (part dimension perpendicular to clamped axis + clearance, rounded up to nearest 5mm)

jaw_height_mm.description: Standard jaw height in mm. Kurt D688 and similar = 38mm. Affects Z clearance.

parallels_mm.description: Height of parallels under part in mm. Null = no parallels (part sits directly on jaw serrations).

clamped_faces.description: Which CAD-space face directions the jaws clamp against. e.g. ['+X', '-X']

rest_face.description: Which CAD-space face direction sits on the parallels or vise body. e.g. '-Z'

datum_face.description: Which face the machinist probes for WCS Z0. e.g. '+Z' means probe top face.

z_zero_face.description: What Z0 represents. top_of_stock: raw billet top. top_of_part: machined face (setup 2+). bottom_of_part: rarely used.

wcs_xy_zero.description: Where X0Y0 is in the WCS. center_of_part: symmetric toolpaths. corner_of_part: all coordinates positive.

clamp_clearance_mm.description: Minimum clearance in mm between top of jaw and lowest tool Z path. Must be > 0 for tool not to hit jaw.

soft_jaw_required.description: True if part geometry requires custom soft jaws instead of standard hard jaws.

soft_jaw_profile_file.description: Filename of generated soft jaw STEP file. Null if not required.

motor_mount_examples._comment: Motor Mount — Setting 1 (raw billet, long axis in X, short axis gripped)
setup_notes: Zero off top face of raw billet
Long axis (104mm) parallel to machine X-axis
Ensure parallels are seated and not rocking before torquing vise
Minimum 25mm jaw engagement each side (55mm part, 65mm jaw opening)
Apply torque evenly to avoid jaw lift

motor_mount_examples._comment: Motor Mount — Setting 2 (flip, previously machined face down)
setup_notes: Flip part 180deg — setting 1 machined face (outer profile) now rests on parallels
Zero off newly exposed raw top face
Face mill will remove 10.8mm of stock from top
Use same parallel height as setting 1 for datum consistency
Verify part is fully supported — do not clamp over machined pockets from setting 1

motor_mount_examples._comment: Motor Mount — Setting 3 (side face, angle plate)
setup_notes: Part rotated 90deg to access side face
Clamp on previously machined top/bottom faces
Probe off +X side face for Z0
Only 2 programs — minor operations on this face
Verify clamp does not obstruct bore access
